QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] SCRS and PSTL 1
QuestInfo.0: Stan the Homeroom Teacher has lots of concerns about the student body. Speak to him.
QuestInfo.1: Stan the Homeroom Teacher wants to know what SCRS is all about and what they are up to. Speak with a Squid in the First Floor Hallway.
QuestInfo.2: SCRS is an acronym for Squid Civil Rights Society. Find out what they want.

default.0: Can you find out about the SCRS? The loud ones standing in the hallway over there.
